newsitem.title: USA: WavePhore, Time in Web content deal.
newsitem.headline: WavePhore, Time in Web content deal.

text.p: WavePhore Inc said Monday it agreed to create a system that will give home personal computer users free access to Time Warner Inc's new "WaveTop" service beginning this fall.

The service will offer multimedia information, entertainment and selected Internet content free including including articles from People, Time and Entertainment Weekly magazines, through the Time Warner's electronic network called Pathfinder.
To receive WaveTop, computer users need to obtain the free WaveTop software and use a computer with a TV tuner already built-in, or buy a low-cost TV tuner add-on card.
A TV tuner allows computers to access information from television, and costs about $100.
WavePhore declined to disclose information on how much money it is investing in the project.
WavePhore provides data delivery and business news to World Wide Web sites and computer users.
